# UBSan ignorelist for Mesa.
#
# Mesa is explicitly not UBSAN clean, but makes a best effort to
# attempt to resolve findings.
#
# Upstream Mesa's `debian-x86_64-ubsan` CI job builds llvmpipe/swrast
# with `-D b_sanitize=undefined` but sets `RUN_MESON_TESTS: "false"`,
# so these runtime UBSan patterns are not caught or suppressed
# upstream.

[null]
# `LIST_FOR_EACH_ENTRY` / `LIST_FOR_EACH_ENTRY_SAFE` (in
# `src/util/list.h`) follow an intrusive linked list pattern which is
# known to trigger UBSAN. Specifically it computes a container pointer
# from the list head sentinel via `offsetof` on loop termination,
# triggering `-fsanitize=null`.
src:*third_party/mesa/src/src/util/u_queue.c
src:*third_party/mesa/src/src/util/u_shader_variant_cache.c
fun:util_queue_killall_threads_locked

# `lp_fence_reference` (in `lp_fence.h`) passes `&old->reference` /
# `&f->reference` to `pipe_reference()` when `old` or `f` may be
# `NULL`, relying on `reference` being at offset `0` and
# `pipe_reference()` checking for `NULL` internally, which triggers
# `-fsanitize=null`.
fun:lp_fence_reference

[object-size]
# Need to replicate the [null] suppressions here, because depending on
# optimizations being applied, they may also trigger [object-size].
# The error message confusingly will point to the first finding found,
# even if it is suppressed, if any of the found findings trigger.
src:*third_party/mesa/src/src/util/u_queue.c
src:*third_party/mesa/src/src/util/u_shader_variant_cache.c
fun:util_queue_killall_threads_locked
fun:lp_fence_reference

[nonnull-attribute]
# `memset(scene->tiles, 0, sizeof(struct cmd_bin) *
# scene->num_alloced_tiles)` passes `NULL` with size `0` when no tiles
# were allocated, triggering `-fsanitize=nonnull-attribute`.
src:*third_party/mesa/src/src/gallium/drivers/llvmpipe/lp_scene.c
